Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
Moved the Empty Retainer icon up by 10px.
Removed the hover tooltip and cursor forcing because the overlay still showed a hover artifact and the hand cursor did not take effect in-game.
The icon remains clickable but has no hover highlight, glow, tooltip, cursor override, or animation.
